objective: Test whether an earlier chronological partition can predict the next 30 seconds of medium/high storage pressure response after a causal 10-second loaded-compressor prefix.

case_definition.target_selection: The bank with the larger prefix rise is selected using prefix data only; the scored 30-second segment is never used for eligibility or target selection.

model.name: bank_specific_robust_continuation_gain
model.calibration: For each bank, median(forecast rate / prefix rate) in the earlier partition, clipped to [-1, 3].

decision_rule: PASS only if every eligibility and primary screen passes. Failure leaves all runtime and reference defaults unchanged.
claim_boundary: A pass supports only a same-site, short-horizon, station-side medium/high pressure-response surrogate. It does not validate compressor capacity, storage geometry, vehicle filling, full-loop behavior, a safety limit, accident frequency, an independent site, or field certification.
